mapper.insert: INSERT INTO et_exam_paper ( name, content, duration, pass_point, total_point, status, summary, is_visible, answer_sheet, group_id, is_subjective, creator, paper_type, field_id, validsource, validdpt, exam_count, answer_hide, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{content}, #{duration}, #{passPoint}, #{totalPoint}, #{status}, #{summary}, #{isVisible}, #{answerSheet}, #{groupId}, #{isSubjective}, #{creator}, #{paperType}, #{fieldId}, #{validsource}, #{validdpt}, #{examCount}, #{answerHide}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, content, duration, pass_point, total_point, status, summary, is_visible, answer_sheet, group_id, is_subjective, creator, paper_type, field_id, validsource, validdpt, exam_count, answer_hide, create_time, update_time FROM et_exam_paper WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, name, content, duration, pass_point, total_point, status, summary, is_visible, answer_sheet, group_id, is_subjective, creator, paper_type, field_id, validsource, validdpt, exam_count, answer_hide, create_time, update_time FROM et_exam_paper ORDER BY create_time DESC
